_doc.zh: 疼痛输入模型（src/painmodel/）所用数值的出处。这是疼痛生理与行为的计算模型，用于教学；被模拟的身体没有主观体验。每条出处都实际打开过；“opened”写明是怎么读的（Europe PMC 的开放全文、PDF 文本，或经摘要工具读取的网页——后一种的引文没有逐字核对）。只取事实和数字，不复制表格或图。
_doc.en: Sources of the numbers used by the pain input model (src/painmodel/). This is a computational model of pain physiology and behaviour for teaching; the simulated body has no subjective experience. Every source was actually opened; 'opened' states how it was read (open full text from Europe PMC, text of a PDF, or a web page read through a summarising tool - quotations obtained that way were not checked character by character). Facts and numbers only; no table or figure is reproduced.

sources.citation: Dubin AE, Patapoutian A. Nociceptors: the sensors of the pain pathway. J Clin Invest 2010;120(11):3760-3772.

sources.opened: PMC page through a summarising fetch tool (first 100,000 characters of the page); the quoted sentences were returned by the tool and not checked character by character

supports.zh: C 纤维传导速度 0.4–1.4 m/s；A 纤维伤害感受器约 5–30 m/s（多数在较慢的 Aδ 范围）；伤害性温度约 >40–45 °C 或 <15 °C；人的 C-MH 多觉型伤害感受器在 39–51 °C 激活；冷痛阈约 15 °C 且不如热痛阈精确；第一痛（刺痛）由 A 纤维、第二痛（灼痛）由 C 纤维和 I 型 A-MH 介导；多觉型是最常见的 C 纤维类型。
supports.en: C-fibre conduction velocity 0.4-1.4 m/s; A-fibre nociceptors about 5-30 m/s (most in the slower Aδ range); noxious temperatures above about 40-45 °C or below about 15 °C; human C-MH polymodal nociceptors active at 39-51 °C; cold pain threshold about 15 °C and less precise than that for heat; first pain (pricking) carried by A fibres, second pain (burning) by C fibres and type I A-MH; polymodal units are the most common C-fibre type.

sources.citation: Jin QQ, Wu GQ, Peng WW, Xia XL, et al. Somatotopic representation of second pain in the primary somatosensory cortex of humans and rodents. J Neurosci 2018.
sources.opened: Europe PMC open full text (XML), searched locally

supports.zh: 引言中的陈述（引自他人）：Aδ 传入约 15 m/s、C 传入约 1 m/s，因此一次强的皮肤伤害性刺激引起先后两种感觉——Aδ 相关的刺痛样第一痛和 C 相关的灼痛样第二痛；刺激手背时激光诱发电位 N2–P2 的峰在约 200–350 ms。
supports.en: Statements in its introduction (citing others): Aδ afferents about 15 m/s and C afferents about 1 m/s, hence a double sensation after one intense cutaneous nociceptive stimulus - an Aδ-related pricking first pain then a C-related burning second pain; the N2-P2 complex of laser-evoked potentials peaks at about 200-350 ms for the hand dorsum.

sources.citation: Rolke R, Baron R, Maier C, Tölle TR, Treede R-D, et al. Quantitative sensory testing in the German Research Network on Neuropathic Pain (DFNS): standardized protocol and reference values. Pain 2006;123:231-243.
sources.license: © 2006 International Association for the Study of Pain; not open access; facts only
sources.opened: text extracted from a PDF copy of the article found on the web; the online Appendix 2 with the per-region mean values was NOT opened

supports.zh: DFNS 方案：热刺激基线 32 °C、探头 9.0 cm²、升温 1 °C/s、上下限 0 和 50 °C；针刺刺激器平头直径 0.2 mm、力 8–512 mN，最强的力约为平均机械痛阈的 8 倍；压痛计探头 1 cm²、50 kPa/s；wind-up：同一针刺力 10 次、1 次/秒，约 5 次后达到平台；所有参数面部比足部敏感，针刺痛阈以手部最不敏感；疼痛阈女性低于男性；左右无差别。各部位的均值只在图和在线附录里，本项目没有取到。
supports.en: The DFNS protocol: thermode baseline 32 °C, contact area 9.0 cm², ramp 1 °C/s, cut-offs 0 and 50 °C; pinprick stimulators with a flat tip of 0.2 mm diameter and forces of 8-512 mN, the strongest being about eight times the mean mechanical pain threshold; pressure algometer with a 1 cm² probe at 50 kPa/s; wind-up: ten pinpricks of one force at 1/s, a plateau after about five stimuli; the face more sensitive than the foot for every parameter, the hand least sensitive for the pinprick threshold; pain thresholds lower in women; no left-right difference. The per-region means are only in a figure and in the online appendix and were not obtained.

supports.zh: 其表 4 把 DFNS（n = 180）的均值与本研究并列：热痛阈手 43.3 °C、足 44.4 °C；冷痛阈手 13.2 °C、足 12.6 °C（DFNS 的数字是经此文转引的，没有对照原文附录）。本研究（墨西哥，n = 50）：热痛阈手 42.7 °C、足 43.7 °C；冷痛阈手 19.7 °C、足 18.9 °C。方法：30 × 30 mm 探头、基线 32 °C、1 °C/s。
supports.en: Its Table 4 sets the DFNS means (n = 180) beside its own: heat pain threshold 43.3 °C hand and 44.4 °C foot; cold pain threshold 13.2 °C hand and 12.6 °C foot (the DFNS figures are quoted through this paper and were not checked against the original appendix). Its own sample (Mexico, n = 50): heat pain 42.7 °C hand, 43.7 °C foot; cold pain 19.7 °C hand, 18.9 °C foot. Method: 30 × 30 mm thermode, baseline 32 °C, 1 °C/s.

supports.zh: 84 名健康人，同一方法测三处（右手大鱼际、右眶上区、右足背）。此处“热痛阈”的判据是 VAS 达到 50–60 mm，不是刚开始痛。18–39 岁组中位数：男 手 44.1、眶上 41.8、足背 43.7 °C；女 手 41.1、眶上 38.0、足背 41.6 °C。足高于手、手高于三叉神经区；女性在手和面部低于男性。
supports.en: 84 healthy people, one method at three sites (right thenar, right supraorbital region, right foot dorsum). Its 'heat pain threshold' is the temperature at which the VAS reaches 50-60 mm, not the first pain. Medians of the 18-39 group: men 44.1 hand, 41.8 supraorbital, 43.7 foot dorsum °C; women 41.1, 38.0, 41.6 °C. Foot higher than hand, hand higher than the trigeminal area; women lower than men on hand and face.

supports.zh: 前臂掌侧接触热刺激（16 × 16 mm 探头，1.5 s 从 32 °C 升到目标温度，持续 8 s，34–50 °C）。全体受试者的痛阈为 44.8 °C（logistic 回归）；温度每升高 1 °C，0–10 VAS 评分升高 0.82（多层回归系数 B）；皮肤电反应和瞳孔扩大随疼痛强度增大，刺激期间（4–8 s）和之后（8–12 s）都存在。量表 0 = 完全没有感觉，1 = 不痛的温热，2 = 痛阈，5 = 中度疼痛，8 = 能忍受的最大疼痛，10 = 能想象的最痛。
supports.en: Contact heat on the volar forearm (16 × 16 mm thermode, 1.5 s ramp from 32 °C to target, 8 s, 34-50 °C). Pain threshold across participants 44.8 °C (logistic regression); the 0-10 VAS rating rises by 0.82 per °C (multilevel regression coefficient B); skin conductance and pupil dilation responses grow with pain intensity, during (4-8 s) and after (8-12 s) the stimulus. Scale: 0 = no sensation at all, 1 = non-painful warmth, 2 = pain threshold, 5 = moderate pain, 8 = maximum tolerable pain, 10 = most pain imaginable.

sources.citation: Wikipedia contributors. Stevens's power law (table of exponents after S. S. Stevens).

supports.zh: 幂函数 ψ = k·I^a 的指数：热痛（辐射热）1.0；冷（金属接触前臂）1.0；手掌受压（静力）1.1；电击 3.5。同页的保留意见：指数是多人平均数据的拟合，个体差异很大。
supports.en: Exponents of ψ = k·I^a: thermal pain (radiant heat) 1.0; cold (metal contact on the arm) 1.0; pressure on the palm (static force) 1.1; electric shock 3.5. The page's own caveat: exponents are fits to data averaged over observers and individuals differ widely.

supports.zh: 158 名健康日本成人（男 85、女 73），1 cm² 探头，30 kPa/s。压痛阈中位数（kPa），男 / 女：腰椎旁肌 548 / 526；臀大肌 564 / 462；股四头肌（髌上 10 cm）415 / 310；胫骨前肌 514 / 379；距腓前韧带 390 / 336。
supports.en: 158 healthy Japanese adults (85 men, 73 women), 1 cm² probe, 30 kPa/s. Median pressure pain thresholds (kPa), men / women: lumbar paravertebral muscle 548 / 526; gluteus maximus 564 / 462; quadriceps (10 cm above the patella) 415 / 310; tibialis anterior 514 / 379; anterior talofibular ligament 390 / 336.

supports.zh: 24 名健康人，1 cm² 探头，约 0.5 kg/cm²/s。压痛阈均值 ± SD（kPa，首测、三次平均）：S1 棘突 522.9 ± 206.9；腰竖脊肌 551.1 ± 201.8；腕背（头状骨）370.5 ± 149.0；前臂屈肌 369.5 ± 122.6。时间总和：256 mN 针刺 10 次、1 Hz，10 次中最高评分减去单次评分（0–10）：手背 2.29 ± 1.45，腰部 1.92 ± 1.32。
supports.en: 24 healthy people, 1 cm² probe, about 0.5 kg/cm²/s. Pressure pain thresholds, mean ± SD (kPa, test occasion, mean of three): S1 spinous process 522.9 ± 206.9; lumbar erector spinae 551.1 ± 201.8; dorsal wrist (capitate) 370.5 ± 149.0; wrist flexor muscles of the forearm 369.5 ± 122.6. Temporal summation: ten 256 mN pinpricks at 1 Hz, highest rating of the series minus the rating of a single stimulus (0-10): hand dorsum 2.29 ± 1.45, low back 1.92 ± 1.32.

supports.zh: 时间总和是 C 纤维介导的现象，需要相同的伤害性刺激以至少 0.33 Hz 重复；第二痛出现在伤害性刺激后约 1–1.5 s（均为其引言和方法中引用他人的陈述）。
supports.en: Temporal summation is a C-fibre-mediated phenomenon requiring identical noxious stimuli repeated at 0.33 Hz or faster; second pain occurs about 1-1.5 s after a noxious stimulus (both are statements in its introduction and methods citing others).

supports.zh: 足底电刺激（5 个 1 ms 方波，200 Hz），记录同侧胫骨前肌肌电。健康对照的反射潜伏期 95.7 ± 23.5 ms；RIII 成分通常取 90–150 ms，更早的 50–90 ms 成分（RII）同样常见、同样疼痛；分析只纳入评分至少 4/10 的疼痛反应，不痛的反射很少。文献中 RII/RIII 的分界在 60–115 ms 之间。
supports.en: Electrical stimulation of the sole (five 1 ms square pulses at 200 Hz), EMG from the ipsilateral tibialis anterior. Reflex latency in healthy controls 95.7 ± 23.5 ms; the RIII component is conventionally taken at 90-150 ms, the earlier 50-90 ms component (RII) was as common and as painful; the analysis kept responses rated at least 4 on 0-10, and non-painful reflexes were rare. The RII/RIII cut-off in the literature lies anywhere between 60 and 115 ms.

sources.citation: Eckert N, Riley ZA. The nociceptive withdrawal reflex does not adapt to joint position change and short-term motor practice. F1000Res 2013;2:158 (version 2).

supports.zh: 示指电刺激（10 个 200 μs 脉冲，300 Hz），10 人。上肢退缩反射是整个肢体的回撤，不随肘、肩角度改变；腕部的合力指向后外侧；记录的肌肉有肱桡肌、肱二头肌、肱三头肌、三角肌前束和后束、拇短展肌。肌电起始潜伏期：三角肌后束 78 ± 11 ms，肱桡肌 86 ± 12 ms。
supports.en: Electrical stimulation of the index finger (ten 200 μs pulses at 300 Hz), 10 people. The upper-limb withdrawal reflex is a generalised withdrawal of the limb, unchanged across elbow and shoulder angles; the resultant force at the wrist points posterior-laterally; muscles recorded were brachioradialis, biceps brachii, triceps, anterior and posterior deltoid, abductor pollicis brevis. EMG onset latencies: posterior deltoid 78 ± 11 ms, brachioradialis 86 ± 12 ms.

sources.citation: Krewer C, Fischer E, Spaich EG, et al. Stimulation of the withdrawal reflex in gait training after stroke: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Artif Organs 2025.

supports.zh: 综述中的陈述（引自他人）：反射呈模块化，各肌肉有各自的皮肤感受野；刺激足底中部和前部引起踝背屈，刺激足跟引起踝跖屈；健康人步行中，足跟离地期的刺激主要引起膝和髋屈曲，足趾离地期的刺激引起踝背屈。
supports.en: Statements in the review (citing others): the reflex is modular, each muscle having its own cutaneous receptive field; stimulation of the mid- and forefoot sole elicits ankle dorsiflexion, stimulation of the heel elicits plantar flexion; in healthy walkers stimulation near heel-off mainly gives knee and hip flexion and near toe-off gives ankle dorsiflexion.

sources.citation: Rapalis A, Piartli P, Jankauskaitė, Marozas, Kaniusas. Induced pain affects auricular and body biosignals: from cold stressor to deep breathing. Front Physiol 2023;14:1090696.

supports.zh: 78 名健康志愿者，左手浸入 7 °C 水 2 分钟（冷加压试验）。相对于之前的静息期，中位数变化：RR 间期 −5.5%，收缩压 +12.6%，舒张压 +13.4%。
supports.en: 78 healthy volunteers, left hand in 7 °C water for 2 minutes (cold pressor test). Median changes against the preceding rest: RR interval -5.5 %, systolic pressure +12.6 %, diastolic pressure +13.4 %.

supports.zh: 对照条件（溶剂）下，右手浸入 4 °C 冰水 1 分钟：开始后 1 分钟收缩压 +16.2 ± 4.1 mmHg、舒张压 +7.7 ± 3.0 mmHg（均值 ± SEM，n = 9）；血压在开始后 1 分钟最高，3 分钟内回到基线。
supports.en: In the control (vehicle) condition, right hand in 4 °C ice water for 1 minute: systolic +16.2 ± 4.1 mmHg and diastolic +7.7 ± 3.0 mmHg one minute after the start (mean ± SEM, n = 9); pressure was highest at one minute and back at baseline within three minutes.

supports.zh: 80 名健康青年（25.2 ± 2.4 岁）仰卧静息：收缩压 111.7 ± 9.7 mmHg，舒张压 62.9 ± 6.6 mmHg，心率 67.1 ± 10.3 次/分。冷刺激期血压和心率显著高于基线和恢复期。
supports.en: 80 healthy young adults (25.2 ± 2.4 years) resting supine: systolic 111.7 ± 9.7 mmHg, diastolic 62.9 ± 6.6 mmHg, heart rate 67.1 ± 10.3 beats/min. Pressure and heart rate were significantly higher in the cold phase than at baseline and in recovery.

supports.zh: 20 名健康女性，针刺和热刺激的强度逐人调到评分 4/10。交感皮肤反应幅度（基线期）：针刺 1.1 ± 1.4 μS、0.9 ± 1.0 μS；热 1.2 ± 1.3 μS、1.1 ± 1.2 μS。背景皮肤电导水平（对照条件）2.5 ± 1.3 μS（针刺时）和 3.4 ± 1.7 μS（热刺激时）。
supports.en: 20 healthy women; pinprick and heat stimuli individually adjusted to a rating of 4 on 0-10. Sympathetic skin response amplitudes (before the pain model): pinprick 1.1 ± 1.4 μS and 0.9 ± 1.0 μS; heat 1.2 ± 1.3 μS and 1.1 ± 1.2 μS. Background skin conductance level (control condition) 2.5 ± 1.3 μS during pinprick and 3.4 ± 1.7 μS during heat.

supports.zh: 34 名丙泊酚麻醉下的病人（不是清醒的人）。给阿片类药之前：基线瞳孔直径 4.00 mm（IQR 3.30–4.50），引起扩瞳所需的电刺激强度中位数 30 mA，瞳孔扩大反射幅度 1.11 mm（IQR 0.91–1.47），变化 28%（IQR 21–39）。
supports.en: 34 patients under propofol anaesthesia (not awake people). Before opioid: baseline pupil diameter 4.00 mm (IQR 3.30-4.50), median electrical stimulation needed 30 mA, pupillary dilation reflex amplitude 1.11 mm (IQR 0.91-1.47), a variation of 28 % (IQR 21-39).

supports.zh: 方法中的陈述：对伤害性反应这类低层次的过程，预期瞳孔反应的峰在伤害性刺激开始后约 500 ms。腓肠神经电刺激的屈肌反射潜伏期约 90 ms。
supports.en: A statement in its methods: for a low-level process such as a nociceptive response the pupil response is expected to peak about 500 ms after the onset of the noxious stimulus. The flexion reflex to sural nerve stimulation has a latency of about 90 ms.

supports.zh: 指尖是痛觉和触觉空间分辨力最高的部位；在上肢有毛皮肤上，痛觉与触觉的空间分辨力沿近远方向的梯度相反；前额处两者相近。各部位的阈值只在图里。
supports.en: The fingertip has the highest spatial acuity for both pain and touch; on the hairy skin of the upper limb the acuity for pain and for touch follow opposite proximal-distal gradients; on the forehead they are similar. The per-site thresholds are in figures only.

supports.zh: 18 名健康志愿者，右前臂掌侧，30 × 30 mm 探头，基线 32 °C、目标 48 °C、平台 6 s、升温 10 °C/s，60 次刺激分 10 组。0–100 mm 疼痛 VAS（0 = 不痛，100 = 能想象的最痛）：第一组平均 57.4 ± 4.5，第十组 72.2 ± 5.4。刺激前该处的热痛阈（极限法，16 × 16 mm 探头）45.39 °C（95% CI 44.24–46.54）。
supports.en: 18 healthy volunteers, right volar forearm, 30 × 30 mm thermode, baseline 32 °C, target 48 °C, 6 s plateau, 10 °C/s rise, 60 stimuli in 10 blocks. 0-100 mm pain VAS (0 = no pain, 100 = worst imaginable pain): mean of the first block 57.4 ± 4.5, of the tenth 72.2 ± 5.4. Heat pain threshold at that site before stimulation (method of limits, 16 × 16 mm thermode) 45.39 °C (95 % CI 44.24-46.54).

supports.zh: 30 名无痛志愿者，左手大鱼际，基线 32 °C、70 °C/s 升温的极限法。高耐受组（18 人，“可忍受的最高疼痛”即 NRS 7 的温度 ≥ 47 °C）：痛阈 42.8 °C（SD 3.3），可忍受阈 47.7 °C（SD 2.3）。
supports.en: 30 pain-free volunteers, left thenar, method of limits from a 32 °C baseline at 70 °C/s. High-tolerance group (18 people whose 'highest tolerable pain', i.e. NRS 7, was at 47 °C or above): pain threshold 42.8 °C (SD 3.3), tolerable threshold 47.7 °C (SD 2.3).
